OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH
Up to $40,000,000 of Shares of its Common Stock
CALDERA RESOURCES CORPORATION
At a Purchase Price Not Greater Than $9.40 Nor Less Than $8.20 Per Share

THE OFFER, PRORATION PERIOD AND WITHDRAWAL RIGHTS EXPIRE AT 12:00 MIDNIGHT, NEW YORK CITY TIME, AT THE END OF THE DAY ON DECEMBER 3, 2026, UNLESS EXTENDED.

Caldera Resources Corporation is offering to purchase for cash up to $40,000,000 of shares of its common stock at a price per share not greater than $9.40 nor less than $8.20, net to the seller in cash, less any applicable withholding taxes and without interest.

Upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Offer, we will determine a single per share purchase price, not greater than $9.40 nor less than $8.20 per Share, that we will pay for Shares validly tendered and not validly withdrawn. All Shares acquired in the Offer will be acquired at the same purchase price, including Shares tendered at a price below the purchase price.

Odd Lots. All Shares properly tendered and not properly withdrawn by any shareholder who owns, beneficially or of record, an aggregate of fewer than 100 Shares, and who validly tenders all of those Shares at or below the purchase price we determine, will be purchased before proration, if any, of the Shares tendered by other shareholders. Partial tenders will not qualify for this preference, and this preference is not available to shareholders who own 100 or more Shares in the aggregate, even if those Shares are registered in more than one name.

The Offer is subject to a minimum tender condition: at least 1,500,000 Shares must be validly tendered and not withdrawn.
